integrity: The proof is constructive for every order under the stated hypotheses. The companion verifier checks finite examples only and is not a formal proof.
scientific_limitations: The decomposition is limited to bipartite bases; the odd cycle C5 gives a counterexample to extending it. The ladder application credits Deniz for path-square well-coveredness and Krapivsky–Luck for the maximal path-square enumerator. The coloring consequence is not a separate priority claim. Publication priority remains provisional for the retained structural claim.
title: Open-packing complexes and maximal-packing polynomials of bipartite prisms
